# PRINTFY 3D

> PRINTFY 3D is a 3D printing business in Cairo, Egypt. It sells ready-made 3D-printed gifts, décor, incense holders, figurines, wall art and accessories, and prints custom orders from a customer's idea, photo, sketch or STL file. Every order is printed in-house in Cairo and delivered across Egypt. Prices are in Egyptian Pounds (EGP).

Website: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/
Tagline: "Your Ideas. Printed." / "Turn Ideas Into Reality."
Languages: English and Arabic

---

## Business summary

- Business type: Online 3D printing business and shop
- Based in: Cairo, Egypt
- Delivery: Across Egypt (delivery fee charged separately, confirmed on WhatsApp)
- Products: Handmade 3D-printed incense holders, figurines, wall art, décor, toys, accessories, personalized gifts (name items, couple sets, keychains) and custom prints
- Production time: Ready-made catalog pieces are printed to order, typically within 24-72 hours. Custom orders take longer depending on complexity; an estimated timeline is shared when the order is confirmed.
- Currency: EGP
- Payment methods: Cash on delivery (50% deposit before production, remaining 50% on delivery) or full payment via InstaPay
- Best way to contact: WhatsApp, usually replies within a few hours

## Why choose PRINTFY 3D

- Printed in Cairo: Every order comes off PRINTFY 3D's own printers in Cairo, with no importing and no waiting on customs.
- Made for your idea: Customers can send a name, a photo or a rough sketch and receive a printed piece made for them.
- Flexible payment: Cash on delivery with a 50% deposit before production, or full payment via InstaPay.
- High-quality printing: Precision printing with premium materials.
- Unique and creative designs: Original pieces.
- Personalized products: Made around what the customer wants.
- Fast and reliable service: Clear timelines and dependable delivery.

URL: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/shop/

Ready-made pieces from the workshop, typically printed within 24-72 hours after ordering. The shop supports product search, sorting (newest, price low to high, price high to low) and min/max price filters (EGP). The full catalog with all products and prices is at https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/shop/. Customers can ask for any item not listed.

All catalog products are printed after an order is placed. Base prices cover the standard product; extra charges may apply for extra colors, gift packaging, logo conversion, new custom designs or rush orders.

## Custom orders

URL: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/custom-orders/

Customers can bring their own design and PRINTFY 3D will print it.

How it works:
1. The customer describes the item and approximate size using the request form on the website (name, phone/WhatsApp, description, size: small/medium/large, color).
2. Upload an STL, 3MF, OBJ, JPG, PNG or PDF file (up to 5 MB) in the custom quote form, or continue through WhatsApp as a fallback. / ارفع ملف STL أو 3MF أو OBJ أو JPG أو PNG أو PDF (حتى 5 ميجابايت) من نموذج عرض السعر المخصص، أو تابع عبر واتساب كخيار بديل.
3. PRINTFY 3D reviews the idea, size and materials, quotes in EGP and confirms details. The customer approves the quote before printing. Then the item is printed in-house and delivered across Egypt.

Replies to custom requests typically come on WhatsApp within a few hours. Custom orders are priced separately after review. Customers can also order through WhatsApp directly: https://wa.me/201063870873?text=Start%20a%20custom%20order

Customization charges apply only to work that takes extra time (for example extra colors, gift packaging, logo conversion, new custom designs and rush orders).

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Are products made to order?
A: Yes. PRINTFY 3D prints catalog products after you order. Custom orders are priced separately after the idea, size and materials are reviewed.

Q: How long does printing take?
A: Standard catalog items are typically printed within 24-72 hours. Custom orders may take longer depending on complexity, and an estimated timeline is shared when the order is confirmed. Delivery times vary by location and courier availability.

Q: How do I pay?
A: Cash on delivery requires a 50% deposit before production; the remaining 50% is due on delivery. Delivery is charged separately. Full payment via InstaPay is also available. Payment details are confirmed on WhatsApp.

Q: Do you deliver across Egypt?
A: Yes. Delivery is available across Egypt, charged separately depending on location.

Q: Can I send my own design?
A: Yes. Send an STL file, photos or sketches on WhatsApp after submitting the custom request form, and PRINTFY 3D will quote in EGP.

## Terms of Service (summary of full terms)

Last updated: September 2026. URL: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/terms/

1. About: PRINTFY 3D is an online 3D printing business based in Cairo, Egypt that designs, prints and delivers 3D-printed décor, figures, toys, accessories, personalized products and custom prints. Using the site or placing an order means agreeing to the terms.
2. Products and custom orders: Both ready-made catalog products and fully custom printing are offered. Custom orders are made from the description, images, files or specifications the customer provides, typically through the website or WhatsApp.
3. Printing variations: 3D printing is layer by layer. Color shade, surface texture and exact dimensions may vary slightly from photos or between prints. These variations are expected and do not necessarily indicate a defect.
4. Customer responsibility: For custom and personalized orders, the customer is responsible for accurate names, spelling, sizes, colors, files and images. Items are printed from what the customer provides.
5. Prices: All prices are in EGP and cover the standard base product. Additional charges may apply for extra colors, gift packaging, logo conversion, new custom designs or rush orders. Delivery is charged separately by location. Prices may change without notice, but the price confirmed at order time is honored.
6. Production and delivery: Catalog items typically take 24-72 hours to print. Custom orders may take longer. Delivery is across Egypt.
7. Customer-provided content: Customers confirm they own the rights to, or have permission to reproduce, any images, logos, designs or 3D files they send. PRINTFY 3D may decline requests that appear to infringe intellectual property or are inappropriate.
8. Payments: For cash on delivery, a 50% deposit of the product total is required before production, with the remaining 50% due on delivery. InstaPay is available for full payment.
9. Changes and cancellations: Changes or cancellation are free before production starts. Once printing has begun, especially for custom or personalized items, they may no longer be possible.
10. Website use: The site must be used for lawful purposes only.
11. Changes to terms: Terms may be updated; continued use means acceptance.
12. Contact: WhatsApp/phone +20 10 63870873, Instagram @3d_printingcairo, Cairo, Egypt.

## Privacy Policy (summary of full policy)

Last updated: September 2026. URL: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/privacy/

- Information collected: Name and phone number; delivery information (address, area, delivery notes); order details (products, quantities, sizes, colors); custom-order information (descriptions, reference images, logos or files). Only information the customer chooses to provide through the website, WhatsApp or Instagram is collected.
- Use of information: To process orders, provide customer support, and handle custom images and files solely to produce the requested item.
- Browser storage and analytics: The site does not use website analytics, advertising trackers or tracking cookies. It uses local browser storage to remember the cart, language preference, privacy notice choice and pending InstaPay order status on the device. This is for site functionality, not tracking.
- Third parties: WhatsApp is used for order communication, and payment providers are used for InstaPay transactions.
- Security: Reasonable steps are taken to protect information, but absolute security cannot be guaranteed.
- Retention: Order information is kept as long as needed to fulfill orders, follow up, and meet basic bookkeeping needs.
- Customer requests: Customers can ask to see, correct or delete their personal information by contacting PRINTFY 3D.
- Policy updates: The policy may be updated from time to time.

---

## Refund and Returns Policy (summary of full policy)

Last updated: September 2026. URL: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/refund-policy/

Every catalog item is printed after an order is placed. Custom orders are quoted and priced separately before production.

1. Standard products: For non-personalized catalog products, customers unhappy with an item should contact PRINTFY 3D within 3 days of delivery so the case can be reviewed and a fair solution found.
2. Damaged or defective items: Message with a photo of the issue within 3 days of delivery. PRINTFY 3D offers a free reprint or a refund depending on the situation.
3. Incorrect products: If the wrong item is sent, PRINTFY 3D arranges a correction (reprint of the right item or a refund) at no extra cost.
4. Custom-made products: Custom and personalized items (such as name keychains, custom name stands, custom logos or fully custom prints) generally cannot be returned or refunded once production has started, except for damaged, defective or incorrect items.
5. Incorrect customer information: If a custom order is printed exactly as specified (for example a name spelled as provided) and the customer later finds a mistake in their own information, it is not considered a defect and standard refund terms may not apply.
6. Damaged deliveries: Contact PRINTFY 3D as soon as possible with photos of the item and packaging for a reprint or refund as appropriate.
7. Refunds: Approved refunds are issued via InstaPay, or in cash if the customer paid cash on delivery, and processed within a few business days. Each case is reviewed individually and a refund is not guaranteed in every situation.
8. Cancellation: Free before production starts. Once printing has begun, cancellation may not be possible, particularly for custom or personalized items.
9. Contact: WhatsApp/phone +20 10 63870873, Instagram @3d_printingcairo.
